comment: Central Scheduler Configuration - Modify this file to customize your schedule

email_notifications.notes: Signal emails contain trade details without workbook attachments. Daily summaries include a trade table and workbook. Weekly summary emails are sent Monday with the previous Monday-Sunday buy/sell report attached as an Excel workbook; the email body contains no trade table.

NIFTYIntra.description: NIFTY Intraday FNO Strategy Monday, Tuesday, and Friday with 3:15 PM IST square-off
NIFTYIntra.notes: Runs Monday, Tuesday, and Friday from 09:30 IST. No new entries after the strategy cutoff; open positions are squared off at 15:15 IST. Scheduler allows until 15:16 for square-off completion. Immediate emails are enabled for each buy and sell signal.

SENSEXINTRA.description: SENSEX Intraday FNO Strategy Wednesday and Thursday with 3:15 PM IST square-off
SENSEXINTRA.notes: Runs Wednesday and Thursday from 09:30 IST. No new entries at or after 15:15 IST. Open positions are squared off then; scheduler allows until 15:16 for completion. Immediate emails are enabled for each buy and sell signal.

NIFTYSupperBuy.notes: Runs Monday through Friday in paper-only mode. BUY confirmation uses two closed 2-minute option candles; buy/sell signals and option-price milestones are emailed, and the daily summary includes completed-trade P&L.

SENSEXSupperBuy.notes: Disabled; run only NIFTYSupperBuy for now.

320trade.notes: 320trade.py uses the same minute-by-minute CE/PE price, P&L, and exit monitoring for both SENSEX and NIFTY in paper-only mode. Selects 100-point ITM strikes at 15:15. Summary email includes paper legs, exit reason, quantity, and estimated P&L.

OILMINI.notes: Runs in its existing day-of-month window from 15:30 to 23:30 IST; scheduler allows until 23:35 for square-off/report completion. Starts first to reduce Groww API contention. Paper-only by default.

GOLDMINI.notes: Runs in its existing day-of-month window from 15:30 to 23:30 IST; scheduler allows until 23:35 for square-off/report completion. Starts after OILMINI to reduce Groww API contention. Paper-only by default.

NATGASMINI.notes: Runs in its existing day-of-month window from 15:30 to 23:30 IST; scheduler allows until 23:35 for square-off/report completion. Starts after OILMINI and GOLDMINI to reduce Groww API contention. Paper-only by default.

SupperWeekScan.description: Weekly stock scanner using Groww weekly candles
SupperWeekScan.notes: Weekly scanner uses Groww weekly candles and sends immediate signal emails on Friday 11:00 PM IST.

run_only_nifty_on_friday.description: To run ONLY NIFTY on Friday 9:15 AM to 3:30 PM

increase_api_delays.description: To prevent rate limit errors, increase delays
